integrity: An unrestricted integral proof via the star cover, relative attaching maps, and augmentation contraction; separate finite exact calculations corroborate but do not prove the infinite-family result. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: An integral S_m-homology-lattice theorem, not an equivariant homotopy equivalence. Only rational homology is asserted for finite group quotients; torsion of quotients and higher-subset Kneser graphs are not determined. Previously published nonequivariant homotopy counts are acknowledged. Equivalent unindexed research remains an originality risk.
title: The integral symmetric-group homology lattice of two-subset Kneser independence complexes
